prompt: The camera does not move. Sophie and the second paramedic take two slow, careful steps along the landing with their open hands out in front of them, moving in step. Later Sophie glances sideways at her colleague and gives the smallest nod. A thin wash of blue light from the stairwell pulses slowly on the wallpaper. The camera does not move. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. Audio: slow footsteps on old carpet, the creak of floorboards, the rustle of waterproof uniform fabric, a radio crackling very quietly downstairs. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
